$doc: PREPARED EVIDENCE ONLY (WP5 section 9, 2026-08-11): one new explicit-ID v2 genesis proposal for the next distributed DOIN component job. Not deployed, not launched; launch requires a DOIN job boundary. Placeholders TBD_AT_JOB_MATERIALIZATION are bound when the component question/domain are materialized under the ordered roadmap; the materializer must fail closed if any placeholder survives into a running worker.
genesis_derivation: doin_core.models.block.Block.genesis('doin-v2-component-job-001-20260811') — fixed Unix-epoch timestamp; every machine recomputes the identical hash independently

pre_claim_identity_check.rule: Every machine prints one DOIN_V2_IDENTITY line with all seven values byte-identical across the fleet BEFORE its first candidate claim; mismatch, absence, or a surviving placeholder is a typed refusal.

boot_mechanics: UnifiedNode.start() initializes an empty DB with the default 'genesis' generator, so the job materializer pre-seeds each worker's fresh state directory via ChainDB.initialize('doin-v2-component-job-001-20260811') before first node start; startup verification then runs the 10-check verifier against the configured genesis_hash and stamps (chain_id, genesis_hash) into database metadata.
constraints: every legacy blockchain database stays byte-for-byte untouched and read-only
the paused 2026-08-06 chain is not resumed and its identity is not reused
no deployment or DOIN optimization launch under this evidence; launch sits at the next DOIN job boundary

validation_evidence.proposal_chain_verifier: 10/10 checks pass, outcome fully_verified, CLI exit 0 (check H)
